C. Output: All evaluations and analyses made at the conference will be reflected in an institutional document (closeout report) that will be translated into English, Spanish and Portuguese and will have the following structure: 
Acceptance criteria: Executive Summary: A brief description of the conference objectives and key outcomes.
・Introduction: Contextualization of the conference, including the central theme and purpose.
・Logistical Details: Information on the date, location and duration of the event. Attendance data and profile of participants.
・Speakers and Presentations: List of speakers and their biographies. Summary of keynote presentations and topics covered.
・Attendee Participation: Summary of attendee participation and active participation. 
・Feedback and Evaluation: Summary of comments, insights and evaluations received from participants.
・Impact on Social Networks: Summary of social media activity during the conference. Mentions, hashtags used and engagement on social platforms.
・Challenges and Lessons Learned: Identification of challenges encountered during the conference. Lessons learned and recommendations for future events.
・Photos and Visual Material: Inclusion of photos and visual material captured during the conference.
